reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual second-round review of external-02 against the exact native source, enlarged source page 14 and targeted source panel, complete unchanged full native RGBA raw, targeted native-resolution face and note/right-edge crops, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa mascot reference; earlier review files were left unchanged

remaining_reasons: The source has a three-quarter head pose facing viewer right with a rightward gaze. The returned native face is nearly frontal with forward-facing, nearly symmetric eyes and a centered mouth, losing the source pose/gaze. Restore the viewer-right three-quarter orientation and rightward gaze.

The source's small dark right-edge tab is not retained as a distinct small tab at the source position and scale; the returned right edge has only ragged tears/notches. Restore that original small right-edge tab without adding a clip or changing the repaired two upper note rows.
entries.positive_observation: The note now has two upper gray-mark rows with no third row, no isolated added dots and no new lower gray clusters; the lower paper is largely blank. The dark olive cap retains a small upper gold eagle, larger lower wreath/cockade, gold braid/piping and glossy black visor. Dark brows remain, with covered hair and no glasses, moustache or beard. The dark olive tunic retains a red standing collar and gold-embroidered red tabs without a visible tie. The rounded chin meets a short broad collar. The complete thin dark frame and opaque dark olive-gray backplate remain, and full white/cyan comparisons show no visible holes, lost backing or working-matte ring. The frontalized pose and missing distinct small right-edge tab are the remaining rejection reasons.
entries.visible_limitations: Exact tiny cap and collar embroidery motifs and all note glyphs are unreadable at source scale. No additional rejection is based on those details; the source pose versus near-frontal return and the small-tab versus ragged-edge difference are directly visible.
